scope: one private acceptance data set; includes all instances, providers, caches and retained recovery fixtures
replacement_method: unlink each pathname, then create separate same-length files with different byte flips; never modify original shared inode in place
allocation_definition: sum(st_blocks * 512) once per distinct (st_dev, st_ino); includes filesystem block rounding, excludes directory entries
comparison_limit: This is the measured acceptance data set, not a general savings ratio or a cold-install benchmark.

source_reference.relationship: Implementation reference; not a recorded binary build attestation.

binary_at_execution.reason: The original report did not record the binary digest or a build-to-commit attestation. No later binary was substituted.

permission_note: The verifier used umask 077; the repaired shared inode is read-only mode 0400.
limits: The two damaged pathnames were unlinked and recreated separately; no live shared inode was modified in place.
Both corrupt files retained the original byte length, exercising digest verification.
The private test root was checked for Java processes before mutation. Original bytes were preserved for failure rollback.
